A pick with 'base' copies that pick and applies the listed overrides. 'example' (used in jobs.json) means the SHL-01 job example's picked hooks (quick track).

concept.title: Razai wapas fluffy
concept.logline: A flat, heavy razai goes to Shubh and comes back fluffed, for ₹249 till 31 Dec.
concept.insight: People give up washing a razai at home: it doesn't fit, doesn't dry, and comes out flat.

story_spine.what_we_see: Flat razai pressed by a hand; price card.
Razai in a bucket, won't fit.
Same razai, flat then fluffed (real job).

risks: Before shot must stay mild (no dirty close-ups).

do: Pay off the hook before the halfway mark.
₹249, 31 Dec and 'pickup free above ₹299' exactly as in the brief.
